final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_avg_hgb FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.overall_avg_hgb AS above_overall FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg_hgb) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall, avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM kept) AS above_kept_average FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC LIMIT 10
